<style>

header{width:100%;max-width:720px;height:52px;flex:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px 1fr 96px;align-items:center}
header h1{font-size:18px;margin:0;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}
#lv{text-align:right;font-weight:700;color:#fbbf24;font-size:14px}

.b{background:#334155;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.b:active{transform:scale(.95)}.b.on{background:#6366f1}
section{width:100%;flex:1;min-height:0}
#menu{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow-y:auto}

<div id="app">
<header><button class="b" id="bk" style="visibility:hidden">☰ Màn</button><h1>🫧 Bubble Shooter</h1><span id="lv"></span></header>
<section id="menu"><p id="sub"></p><div id="grid"></div><p class="hp">Ngắm và bắn bóng lên trần. 3 bóng cùng màu trở lên sẽ nổ. Dọn sạch bóng màu trước khi chúng chạm vạch đỏ.</p></section>
<section id="play" hidden><div id="info"></div><div id="board"></div><div id="msg"></div><div id="ctl"></div></section>
<div id="md" hidden><div class="box"><h2 id="mt"></h2><p id="mx"></p><div id="mb"></div></div></div>
</div>
<script>
const GAME={key:'bubble'};
const MAX=100,KEY='gp_'+GAME.key;
let prog=0,L=1,over=false;
try{prog=Math.min(MAX,+localStorage.getItem(KEY)||0)}catch(e){}
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,prog)}catch(e){}};
const rng=s=>()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296};
const side=x=>Math.max(200,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-215-(x||0),720));
const setInfo=h=>{$('#info').innerHTML=h},say=t=>{$('#msg').textContent=t||''};
const stop=()=>{if(typeof onStop=='function')onStop()};
function fitMenu(){const s=Math.max(240,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-175,640)),g=$('#grid');g.style.width=g.style.height=s+'px';g.style.fontSize=Math.max(11,s/10*.36)+'px'}
function menu(){
 stop();$('#play').hidden=true;$('#menu').hidden=false;$('#md').hidden=true;
 $('#bk').style.visibility='hidden';$('#lv').textContent='';
 $('#sub').textContent='Đã qua '+prog+'/'+MAX+' màn';
 let h='';for(let i=1;i<=MAX;i++)h+='<button class="'+(i<=prog?'done':i==prog+1?'cur':'lock')+'" data-l="'+i+'"'+(i>prog+1?' disabled':'')+'>'+i+'</button>';
 $('#grid').innerHTML=h;fitMenu();
}
function play(l){
 stop();L=l;over=false;$('#md').hidden=true;$('#menu').hidden=true;$('#play').hidden=false;
 $('#bk').style.visibility='visible';$('#lv').textContent='Màn '+l;
 const b=$('#board');b.className='';b.removeAttribute('style');b.innerHTML='';b.onclick=b.onpointerdown=b.onpointermove=b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=null;
 $('#ctl').innerHTML='';say('');setInfo('');start(l);
}
function modal(t,x,btns){$('#mt').textContent=t;$('#mx').textContent=x;const m=$('#mb');m.innerHTML='';
 btns.forEach(a=>{const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='b '+(a[2]||'');e.textContent=a[0];e.onclick=a[1];m.appendChild(e)});$('#md').hidden=false}
function win(x){if(over)return;over=true;if(L>prog){prog=L;save()}stop();
 setTimeout(()=>{if(!$('#menu').hidden)return;const fin=L>=MAX,bt=[];if(!fin)bt.push(['Màn tiếp ▶',()=>play(L+1),'on']);bt.push(['Chơi lại',()=>play(L)],['Chọn màn',menu]);
  modal(fin?'🏆 Hoàn thành cả 100 màn!':'🎉 Qua màn '+L+'!',x||'',bt)},450)}
function fail(x){if(over)return;over=true;stop();modal('Chưa được',x||'',[['Thử lại',()=>play(L),'on'],['Chọn màn',menu]])}
$('#grid').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b&&!b.disabled)play(+b.dataset.l)};
$('#bk').onclick=menu;
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!$('#menu').hidden)fitMenu();else if(typeof relayout=='function')relayout()});

const BC=['#ef4444','#3b82f6','#22c55e','#eab308','#a855f7','#f97316'],STN=7,LR=10,COLS=9,RWS=LR+3;
let cv,cx,CW,CH,r_,K,descN,since,par,gd,cur,nxt,aim,shot,fx,raf,dead,lastT,sx,sy,dpr,stoneP;
const oS=row=>(row+par)%2,px=(row,c)=>r_*(1+2*c+oS(row)),py=row=>r_*(1+row*1.7321);
function nbrs(row,c){const d=oS(row)?[0,1]:[-1,0],o=[[row,c-1],[row,c+1]];for(const dr of[-1,1])for(const dc of d)o.push([row+dr,c+dc]);return o.filter(a=>a[0]>=0&&a[0]<RWS&&a[1]>=0&&a[1]<COLS)}
function colored(){let n=0;gd.forEach(r=>r.forEach(v=>{if(v>0&&v<STN)n++}));return n}
function rcol(){const s=new Set();gd.forEach(r=>r.forEach(v=>{if(v>0&&v<STN)s.add(v)}));const a=[...s];return a.length?a[Math.random()*a.length|0]:1}
function start(l){
 dead=false;K=Math.min(6,3+Math.floor(l/20));const rows0=Math.min(8,4+Math.floor(l/15));descN=Math.max(3,8-Math.floor(l/14));since=0;par=0;shot=null;fx=[];aim=Math.PI/2;
 stoneP=l<30?0:Math.min(.12,(l-25)*.0016);
 gd=Array.from({length:RWS},()=>Array(COLS).fill(0));
 for(let r=0;r<rows0;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){let v=1+Math.random()*K|0;if(c&&Math.random()<.35)v=gd[r][c-1];else if(r&&Math.random()<.3)v=gd[r-1][c];if(r>0&&Math.random()<stoneP)v=STN;gd[r][c]=v}
 cur=rcol();nxt=rcol();
 const b=$('#board');b.className='bs';b.innerHTML='<canvas></canvas>';cv=b.firstChild;cx=cv.getContext('2d');
 cv.onpointerdown=cv.onpointermove=e=>setAim(e);
 cv.onpointerup=e=>{if(over||shot)return;setAim(e);fire()};
 $('#ctl').innerHTML='<button class="b" id="sw">🔁 Đổi bóng</button>';
 $('#ctl').onclick=()=>{if(!shot&&!over){const t=cur;cur=nxt;nxt=t}};
 relayout();say('Chạm/kéo để ngắm, nhả tay để bắn. 3 bóng cùng màu trở lên sẽ nổ.');
 cancelAnimationFrame(raf);lastT=0;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
function onStop(){dead=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf)}
function relayout(){if(!cv)return;const aw=Math.min(innerWidth-20,460),ah=innerHeight-205;r_=Math.max(10,Math.min(aw/(2*COLS+1),ah/(1+LR*1.7321+3.4)));CW=r_*(2*COLS+1);CH=r_*(1+LR*1.7321+3.4);dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;cv.width=CW*dpr;cv.height=CH*dpr;cv.style.width=CW+'px';cv.style.height=CH+'px';sx=CW/2;sy=CH-r_*1.4}
function setAim(e){const rc=cv.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-rc.left)*CW/rc.width,y=(e.clientY-rc.top)*CH/rc.height,dx=x-sx,dy=sy-y;let a=dy<=0?(dx>=0?.2:Math.PI-.2):Math.atan2(dy,dx);aim=Math.max(.2,Math.min(Math.PI-.2,a))}
function hitB(x,y){for(let r=0;r<RWS;r++){const yy=py(r);if(Math.abs(yy-y)>2*r_)continue;for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(gd[r][c]){const dx=px(r,c)-x,dy=yy-y;if(dx*dx+dy*dy<(1.75*r_)*(1.75*r_))return true}}return false}
function trace(){const p=[];let x=sx,y=sy,vx=Math.cos(aim),vy=-Math.sin(aim);const st=r_*.5;for(let i=0;i<500;i++){x+=vx*st;y+=vy*st;if(x<r_){x=r_;vx=-vx}if(x>CW-r_){x=CW-r_;vx=-vx}if(y<=r_||hitB(x,y))break;if(i%4==3)p.push([x,y])}return p}
function fire(){shot={x:sx,y:sy,vx:Math.cos(aim),vy:-Math.sin(aim),c:cur}}
function loop(t){if(dead)return;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);const dt=Math.min(40,t-(lastT||t));lastT=t;upd(dt);draw()}
function upd(dt){
 if(shot){const n=Math.max(1,Math.round(3*dt/16.7)),st=r_*.45;
  for(let i=0;i<n&&shot;i++){shot.x+=shot.vx*st;shot.y+=shot.vy*st;if(shot.x<r_){shot.x=r_;shot.vx=-shot.vx}if(shot.x>CW-r_){shot.x=CW-r_;shot.vx=-shot.vx}if(shot.y<=r_||hitB(shot.x,shot.y))land()}}
 fx.forEach(f=>{f.t+=dt;if(f.k=='f'){f.vy+=.0012*dt*(r_/20);f.y+=f.vy*dt}});fx=fx.filter(f=>(f.k=='p'?f.t<250:f.y<CH+r_))
}
function land(){
 const x=shot.x,y=shot.y,c0=shot.c;shot=null;let best=null,bd=1e18;
 for(let r=0;r<RWS;r++){const dy=py(r)-y;if(Math.abs(dy)>2.4*r_)continue;for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){if(gd[r][c])continue;if(r>0&&!nbrs(r,c).some(a=>gd[a[0]][a[1]]))continue;const dx=px(r,c)-x,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(d<bd){bd=d;best=[r,c]}}}
 if(!best)best=[0,Math.max(0,Math.min(COLS-1,Math.round((x/r_-1-oS(0))/2)))];
 const[r,c]=best;gd[r][c]=c0;let popped=0;
 const seen=new Set([r*COLS+c]),q=[[r,c]];while(q.length){const[a,b]=q.pop();nbrs(a,b).forEach(([y2,x2])=>{const k=y2*COLS+x2;if(!seen.has(k)&&gd[y2][x2]==c0){seen.add(k);q.push([y2,x2])}})}
 if(seen.size>=3){seen.forEach(k=>{const a=k/COLS|0,b=k%COLS;fx.push({k:'p',x:px(a,b),y:py(a),c:gd[a][b],t:0,vy:0});gd[a][b]=0;popped++})}
 const con=new Set(),st=[];for(let b=0;b<COLS;b++)if(gd[0][b]){con.add(b);st.push([0,b])}
 while(st.length){const[a,b]=st.pop();nbrs(a,b).forEach(([y2,x2])=>{const k=y2*COLS+x2;if(gd[y2][x2]&&!con.has(k)){con.add(k);st.push([y2,x2])}})}
 for(let a=0;a<RWS;a++)for(let b=0;b<COLS;b++)if(gd[a][b]&&!con.has(a*COLS+b)){fx.push({k:'f',x:px(a,b),y:py(a),c:gd[a][b],t:0,vy:0});gd[a][b]=0;popped++}
 cur=nxt;
 if(!colored()){nxt=1;win('Đã dọn sạch tất cả bóng màu!');return}
 nxt=rcol();
 if(popped)since=0;else{since++;if(since>=descN){since=0;const row=Array.from({length:COLS},()=>Math.random()<stoneP?STN:1+Math.random()*K|0);gd.unshift(row);gd.pop();par^=1;say('Trần vừa hạ xuống một hàng!')}}
 for(let a=LR;a<RWS;a++)if(gd[a].some(v=>v)){draw();fail('Bóng đã chạm vạch đỏ ở dưới.');return}
 setInfo('Hạ trần sau: <b>'+(descN-since)+'</b> lượt · Bóng màu còn: <b>'+colored()+'</b>');
}
function bub(x,y,c,s){cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,r_*(s||1)-1,0,7);cx.fillStyle=c==STN?'#64748b':BC[c-1];cx.fill();cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x-r_*.3,y-r_*.3,r_*.28*(s||1),0,7);cx.fillStyle='#ffffff66';cx.fill()}
function draw(){
 cx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);cx.clearRect(0,0,CW,CH);
 const ly=py(LR)-r_;cx.setLineDash([6,6]);cx.strokeStyle='#ef4444';cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(0,ly);cx.lineTo(CW,ly);cx.stroke();cx.setLineDash([]);
 for(let r=0;r<RWS;r++)for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++)if(gd[r][c])bub(px(r,c),py(r),gd[r][c]);
 if(!shot&&!over){cx.fillStyle='#fff8';trace().forEach(p=>{cx.beginPath();cx.arc(p[0],p[1],2.2,0,7);cx.fill()})}
 fx.forEach(f=>{if(f.k=='p')bub(f.x,f.y,f.c,Math.max(.05,1-f.t/250));else bub(f.x,f.y,f.c,1)});
 if(shot)bub(shot.x,shot.y,shot.c);else bub(sx,sy,cur);
 bub(r_*1.4,CH-r_*1.4,nxt,.7);
}

menu();
</script></body></html>
